description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling e-signature operations including initiation, listing, retrieval by ID, and callback simulation. It references a controller module for business logic and middleware for authentication.

methods.name: router.post('/initiate')
methods.description: Route to initiate an e-sign request, protected by auth middleware, handled by esignController.initiate.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Route to list e-sign requests, protected by auth middleware, handled by esignController.list.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Route to retrieve a specific e-sign request by ID, protected by auth middleware, handled by esignController.getOne.

methods.name: router.post('/callback/simulate')
methods.description: Route to simulate e-sign provider callback for updating request status, handled by esignController.simulateCallback.
